blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around P43.27 million worth of suspected shabu, or methamphetamine hydrochloride, brought by a Romanian national was seized by authorities at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) in Pasay City, according to the Philippine National Police (PNP).
